workload_help:
usage:
  posix-workload --help
  posix-workload prepare --root DIR --family FAMILY --total-bytes N --block-bytes N --concurrency 1|8 --generation N --trace FILE
  posix-workload run --root DIR --family FAMILY --total-bytes N --block-bytes N --concurrency 1|8 --generation N --barrier read-close|owner-close|ext4-close-compensating-fdatasync|fdatasync|fsync --target owner|ext4 --trace FILE
  posix-workload verify --root DIR --family FAMILY --total-bytes N --block-bytes N --concurrency 1|8 --generation N --trace FILE
families: seq-read, seq-write, random-read, random-overwrite
stdout: one JSON summary. trace: JSON lines header, worker lifecycle records, and one record per I/O operation.
